_comment: Gap backlog for the autonomous /loop gap-fill run. Populated 2026-07-09 from the GPT-5.6-terra shipped-skills audit (memory-bank/status-updates/shipped-skills-gap-audit-2026-07-09.html). Each tick, tools/gap_driver.py pulls the highest-priority pending item, works it in its own worktree via the routed GPT-5.6 tier, has Sol review, and folds it in. Status: pending -> in_progress -> review -> merged | review_failed | blocked.

items.title: Port the five deferred emulator fishing methods
items.detail: karambwanji net, rainbow fish, lava eel (oily rod), Lumbridge swamp slimy-eel/frog-spawn dual-output, cave eel. See DEFERRED_FISHING_CONTENT in fishing_data.py:282-317. Source rows already in game-main Fish.kt / FishingTool.kt / FishingSpot.kt.

blocking: fishing_data.py registers cave_eel with source_tool CAVE_EEL and no bait, but game-main FishingTool.kt defines no CAVE_EEL tool and FishingSpot.kt has no corresponding binding; only Fish.CAVE_EEL exists, so this invents a baitless emulator method.

The newly live outputs are not registered with Fishing assets: test_every_fishing_output_resolves_an_icon fails for Frog spawn, Raw cave eel, Raw karambwanji, Raw lava eel, and Raw rainbow fish, and the new Fishing definitions also make the existing Cooking and quest-stage icon tests fail by shadowing their valid assets.

Raw karambwanji, Raw lava eel, and Frog spawn are exported with tradeable=true through the FishingFish default, contrary to game-main items.yml for item IDs 3150, 2148, and 5004, all of which are non-tradeable.
verdict.notes: Rejected. All five requested IDs are present, their existing Fish.kt item/level/chance/XP rows are exact, and both python -c "import fishing_data" and tests.test_fishing_data pass. The commit is nevertheless not foldable as-is because cave eel is not a faithful source-backed method, the newly activated item metadata is wrong for three outputs, and the activation leaves live targets without assets while regressing existing registry invariants. No unrelated refactor or combat/Prayer edit was found.

blocking: Completeness/parity: PotteryData.kt:280-309 defines PRAYER_URNS, but crafting_data.py ends the urn catalogue at strong smelting urn and omits all nine form/fire/add-rune recipes for Impious, Accursed, and Infernal urns (levels 2/26/62; forming XP 12.0/25.0/40.0; firing XP 18.0/37.5/60.0; Air rune; 1.0 rune-attachment XP). These are required Crafting catalogue rows and do not require changing Prayer training or combat code.
verdict.notes: Do not fold this commit into main as-is. The mandated import passes, the commit changes only crafting_data.py, the focused Crafting data tests pass, and the 60 added Mining, Cooking, Fishing, Woodcutting, and Smelting recipe rows match the emulator's levels, forming/firing XP, rune types, and the module's established three-stage naming and automatic registration conventions. However, the emulator catalogue contains 26 urn products and therefore 78 form/fire/add-rune recipes, while this branch exposes only 23 products and 69 recipes; omitting the complete PRAYER_URNS family directly leaves the stated catalogue task incomplete.
